Allow loads below the usual 80% cargo threshold; existing construction and other exceptions still apply.
Add the source station's sale wares as target tradewares and allow the target to buy and sell them. Disabling this option does not remove wares already added.
Trigger distribution when the receiving station is below this stock percentage, subject to the supplying station threshold and cargo requirements.
The supplying station must be above this stock percentage to start a transfer. This is not a guaranteed reserve after the transfer.
Allow distribution above the receiving station minimum when the supplying station exceeds this percentage and is more than 10 percentage points fuller than the receiver; other thresholds still apply.
Procures supplies for the home station or stations in the configured service area.
Assign to the home station if it's the players.

With a player station as home, supply only that station and its construction storage. With a sector as home, supply player stations in that sector. Disabling allows other player stations within range. Suppliers may be in other sectors within range. An explicitly selected NPC home follows its own NPC service rules.

When enabled, prefer eligible owned factories or warehouses for main and secondary lots; use NPC supply for unavailable or insufficient owned supply. When disabled, eligible owned and NPC sources compete under the same distance and price rules. The owned stock threshold and all range, path and trade checks apply in both modes. The NPC source switch controls NPC sources only.
Allows buys from AI Faction Stations.
Buy materials for delivery to the receiving station's construction storage, for building or expansion. This does not collect goods from construction storage.

Supply wares the receiver consumes or needs for resupply but does not produce itself, such as microchips for an advanced electronics factory. This is a receiver-use category, not a restriction to ore or gas. The ship must still carry the ware.
Supply wares the receiver both produces and consumes. For example, an integrated factory can buy refined metals when its own production cannot keep up with hull-part production.
Locks the ware selection, otherwise we need to wipe it each time we call the script.
Maximum procurement lots per trip (1–10). One supplier, one ware and one receiver count as one lot. Deliveries do not count again.
Owned Station Buy price adjustment, 0=ignore manager price 100= Obey Station Manager's buy offer.
Will wait for build storage needs instead of finding something to do.
Will look to supply only factories with products.
Assign to the home station if it's the players.
Maximum procurement lots per trip. The capacity dispatcher supports multiple pickups followed by deliveries.

Minimum total planned load per trip. Normal allocation runs from largest cargo capacity to smallest; remaining demand then runs from smallest to largest without this minimum. Maximum lots and all trade rules still apply.
Work per candidate batch. Lower values yield more often; candidates are not randomly discarded.
Maximum jumps from the fixed home-to-primary-supplier route for secondary pickups. All suppliers must also remain inside the original home range. Zero means route sectors only.
Comparison price = actual price × (1 + off-route jumps × percent / 100). Only ranks competing suppliers of the same ware. Zero disables markup, not the corridor radius.
%s: no executable procurement for %s within %s home jumps. Last rejection: %s.
%s: incomplete submission; queued orders are withdrawn where possible. Running orders remain. After all orders end, remaining cargo is liquidated at ware average price. See M4 Capacity Dispatch.
%s has remaining cargo that cannot currently be delivered to its planned receiver/home. Cargo is preserved. Check offers, funds and trade rules.

Current ware stock divided by allocated ware storage; default 50%. Stock must strictly exceed the threshold in both preference modes. This is an eligibility trigger, not a retained reserve: an accepted shipment may take all legally offered stock. Zero allows positive stock; 100 requires stock above allocation. Zero allocation is skipped. Owned transfers ignore profit spread.
No unmet demand matches service scope, ware category and cargo compatibility.
No indexed supplier quote for this ware; waiting for quote updates.
Cannot resolve actual partner price: quote may have disappeared, become restricted or changed. Skip and retry.
Owned stock does not exceed trigger: %s ware=%s stock=%s allocated=%s threshold=%s%%. Skip this supplier.
Price spread rejected: ware=%s supplier=%s actual buy=%s Cr receiver=%s actual bid=%s Cr. External procurement requires bid above ask. Supplier raw quote=%s Cr.
Outside corridor: supplier=%s deviation=%s jumps allowed=%s.

Insufficient quantity/minimum lot: supplier=%s ware=%s net demand=%s net supply=%s free volume=%s after native storage/funds clamp=%s supplier minimum=%s receiver minimum=%s remaining budget=%s Cr actual buy=%s Cr.
No reachable transport route under this ship travel blacklist.
Trip load below threshold: volume=%s capacity=%s required=%s%% lots=%s maximum=%s. Normal pass defers to ascending relaxed allocation.
Offer/station invalid or ship not operational.
Range/unreachable: station=%s legal jumps=%s maximum=%s; negative means no legal path.
Native quote unavailable to this ship: station=%s ware=%s. Trade rules, activity blacklists, withdrawn quotes or reservations may apply; native query gives no finer reason.
No compatible trade dock at %s for this ship; temporarily occupied berths do not count as incompatible.
Cargo drones missing: neither this ship nor trading station %s has cargo drones for freight transfer.
NPC purchases are disabled; NPC supplier %s is excluded.
Supplier quote is invalid or has no remaining quantity, possibly reserved by other transports.
%s: liquidated %s, %s units at average %s Cr/unit; credited player %s Cr. No station delivery occurred.
%s: commit revalidation failed; no orders created. See adjacent COMMIT_CHECK records.
Revalidation failed: %s; ship=%s supplier=%s ware=%s planned=%s.
Actual price changed or modifier expired
Owned source no longer exceeds stock trigger
Net demand/supply no longer covers reserved plan
Ship orders, assignment or settings changed
Cannot return to home %s: no route from the current sector complies with this ship's travel blacklist. Trade searches will continue and return will be retried.
%s (%s) could not be assigned to %s. M4 will continue searching for trades. Assignment diagnostics are stored on the pilot and can be inspected in a save.
%s (%s) has a sector as home and cannot be assigned as a station subordinate. Select a specific station in the M4 home setting to enable assignment. Sector supply mode will continue.
